description:
If you want a fast, low-maintenance machine that mostly lives in the browser, few options are as compelling as a Chromebook.

Chromebooks don’t try to do everything, which is exactly why they’re so appealing. For this roundup, we focused on models that stay fast under real use and makes it through a full day unplugged. Every pick here was tested hands-on.

If you’d rather step outside Google’s ecosystem, PCWorld has a separate roundup of the best Windows laptops. And if you’re curious where Chromebooks are headed next, check
title: Best Chromebooks 2026: Top picks for work, school, and more
